maxResults.title: Maximum written reports
maxResults.description: Return the newest 1–1,000 matching written reports. Start with 10 to try it. Uses the latest maintainer snapshot, generally monthly.

filter.title: Game or hardware filter (optional)
filter.description: Leave blank for all games. Examples: game:292030 for The Witcher 3, or hardware:NVIDIA to match the public GPU, OS or driver text.
